lines.text: Sangoma announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by BRC Group Holdings on September 28, 2026, a strong, high-confidence news catalyst that the desk reads as plausibly explaining the move. The structure is unknown; the desk cannot independently verify the float, and shares outstanding are 33,338,932 as of June 30, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), with registered resale and warrants both unknown. The sheet places the name green, fresh / frontside.

SoundThinking announced a definitive merger agreement under which Transom Capital Group will acquire the company through a tender offer for $8.00 per share in cash plus one non-transferable CVR worth up to $3.00 per share, a strong, medium-confidence news catalyst that the desk reads as plausibly explaining the move. The structure is caution; the desk cannot independently verify the float, and shares outstanding are 13,163,790 as of August 5, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), with other issued shares listed as unknown at 791,298 shares and 1,543,920 shares. The sheet places the name green, fresh / frontside.

Faraday Future disclosed a term sheet on September 28, 2026, for a proposed transaction in which AIxC would acquire the robotics business at an expected $200 million purchase price paid in AIxC common stock and non-voting convertible preferred stock; the desk grades this moderate / mixed / secondary with high confidence and reads it as plausibly explaining the move. The structure is unknown, and the desk cannot independently verify the float; the proposal remains subject to special-committee review, a favorable recommendation, definitive documentation and other conditions. The sheet places the name at no cycle conclusion.

A September 29, 2026 secondary report said Roth Capital initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $3.50 price target, a moderate / mixed / secondary catalyst with medium confidence that the desk reads as plausibly explaining the move. The desk cannot independently verify the float, and shares outstanding are 127,255,223 as of July 24, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float); the structure is caution, with an atm known active effective September 18, 2026 and shelf capacity possibly active effective September 18, 2026. The sheet places the name at no cycle conclusion.

At 03:38 ET, September 29, 2026, a secondary-news headline reported a partnership with Al Majlis Group to offer phishing-resistant biometric authentication in the UAE and Saudi Arabia; the desk grades the fresh news legitimate positive with medium confidence and reads it as plausibly explaining the move. The structure is dirty float, the desk cannot independently verify the float, and shares outstanding are 1,436,344 as of August 11, 2026 (the outstanding count, not a float), with registered resale possibly active at 618,334 shares effective December 1, 2025, plus warrants not yet active at 1,236,668 shares and warrants unknown at 3,091,668 shares effective May 5, 2025. The sheet places the name yellow, frontside warning.

At 07:38 ET, September 29, 2026, a secondary report attributed the move to an assertion of meeting Nasdaq’s $2.5 million equity requirement following acquisitions; the desk grades this moderate / mixed / secondary with medium confidence, with the September 28, 2026 Form 6-K providing a primary-company acquisition backdrop but not independently establishing the compliance conclusion. The desk cannot independently verify the float; supply includes registered resale possibly active at 42,307,692 shares, convertibles possibly active, and acquisition shares known active effective September 10, 2026. The sheet marks down 13.1% since the previous checkpoint and gives no cycle conclusion.

At 07:15 ET, September 29, 2026, Polar Power announced a trial order for 50 propane-fueled DC generators from a major Southeast Asian telecom operator, while secondary coverage described a potential five-year revenue opportunity of up to $60M; the desk grades the fresh news legitimate positive with high confidence and reads it as plausibly explaining the move. The structure is caution, the desk cannot independently verify the float, and supply includes registered resale possibly active at 8,653,774 shares effective September 25, 2026, convertibles possibly active, an equity purchase agreement possibly active, preferred conversion possibly active effective September 25, 2026, and warrants possibly active at 382,276 shares effective September 25, 2026. The sheet places the name at no cycle conclusion.
